subject: Privileged review orchestration & comm drafts
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privileged review orchestration & comm drafts

Team —

I want to lock down the plan for this year's performance review cycle focusing on sensitive-handling, manager calibration, and how we route exceptions for folks on PIPs / legal holds. High level asks below; I've attached the current drafts (manager_guidelines_v2.docx, confidential-handling-checklist.pdf, and an initial .ics calendar).

Key asks for this thread:
- Confirm review calendar windows and blackout dates (see attached .ics).
- Agree on who receives privileged comms (Legal, People Ops, and manager chain).
- Finalize which managers need one-on-one calibration sessions vs. group calibration.
- Approve the comm drafts for employees and managers, plus an executive note for leadership.

Constraints / notes:
- We must prevent review-related comms to employees under active investigations; Legal will provide a suppressed list.
- For distributed teams in EU & APAC, we need a slightly later close date to accommodate local holidays; Laura, can you confirm dates?
- Marcus, please confirm whether Dedicated has any resource conflicts with review calibration training windows.

My suggested timeline (tentative):
1) May 25 — final manager guidelines + suppression list from Legal
2) May 28 — manager calibration materials published and manager comms sent (managed send)
3) June 7 — employee self-reflection open
4) June 28 — manager reviews due

Please comment inline or reply with approvals. If you prefer a short sync, I can carve 30 minutes Monday.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of People Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: manager_guidelines_v2.docx (docx, 245 KB); confidential-handling-checklist.pdf (pdf, 110 KB); review_calendar_2026.ics (calendar file)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged review orchestration & comm drafts

Eve —

Thanks for the clear outline. Quick notes:
- I reviewed manager_guidelines_v2.docx. Mostly good; I have one tightening suggestion under "Escalation Flow" so managers don't CC direct reports when escalating to Legal. I pasted the snippet below for inclusion.

- For suppression list: Legal already has a working list and will send csv by EOD May 25. I'll coordinate to get it into our notification suppression pipeline.

- Calibration: recommend 1:1 for any manager with >6 directs or anyone with a direct report on a performance plan. Group calibration (1-hour) for smaller teams.

- Timeline: can we push the manager comms to May 29 to give us a full day after the suppression list? Otherwise we risk accidental sends.

If everyone is comfortable, I can run a test send to a 10-manager sample Monday morning.

Monica
Monica Patel
Director, People Operations

From: Tamara Steele <tamara.steele@hrconsult.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Privileged review orchestration & comm drafts

Hi Evelyn and Monica —

Thanks for looping us in. A few compliance points from our side after reviewing the checklist:
1) For EU employees, ensure the suppression flag is persisted for at least 90 days in case of GDPR right-to-erasure processes that occur mid-cycle.
2) For employees on parental leave, best practice is to delay both manager and employee-facing comms until the employee is back or explicitly opted in.
3) Make sure the manager_guidelines_v2 wording around "documentation retention" matches existing data retention policies — I recommend the following short paragraph to add under Records: "All calibration artifacts stored in People Drive must be marked 'Restricted - People Ops' and retained per Redwood retention policy. Managers should not download or share artifacts via personal accounts."

I attached a short redline (weblink to doc in our comments). Happy to jump on a 30-minute call to walk through sensitive cases Wednesday.

Best,
Tamara Steele
Principal, HR Compliance (Consulting)
HRConsult

Attachments: compliance_redline_comments.docx (link to comments)

All —

Quick operational check from Dedicated / Learning side: the week of May 28 we have a platform update (infrastructure deployment) that will affect session-based training delivery (video/live workshops). Recommend we move the training window to June 1–4 for manager calibration workshops to avoid any platform slippage. That keeps deliverables intact and gives managers a little more time to review materials.

Also: if we're doing a managed send of manager comms, please flag the send to the Redwood admin account and include a 24-hour hold before escalation, so we can catch any accidental audiences.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Developer Ops, Dedicated Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Evelyn / all —

Thanks for the updates and the external compliance notes. Summary and approvals below:
- Laura (me) confirms EU/APAC close dates: employees in EU will have self-reflection open June 10 and managers' reviews due July 1; APAC teams will have a June 12 open and July 3 manager due date. I'll publish a region-specific calendar in the Drive link tonight.
- Monica: agree to push the manager comms to May 29, and Marcus' suggestion to move manager calibration workshops to June 1–4 works for me.
- Legal suppression list: once we have the csv, People Ops will ingest and we'll run a dry-run on May 31 to validate suppression logic against our test tenant.

Approvals: I approve the manager_guidelines_v2.docx with Monica's escalation wording and Tamara's Records paragraph inserted. Please send the manager comms May 29 at 10:00 AM PT (managed send to admin for hold).

If there are no further objections, I'll mark this thread approved and publish the finalized materials to the Drive folder.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People & Talent
Redwood Inference
